# Packer 1.14.2

Official binary archives for Linux AMD64 and macOS ARM64, bundled for local installation.
Source: https://releases.hashicorp.com/packer/1.14.2/
SHA256 values are kept in the original HashiCorp checksums file.
Install with `./scripts/install-packer.sh` from the repository root.
HashiCorp license is included inside each ZIP as LICENSE.txt.
